summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the grid-stability node with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane uses GE Vernova as the obvious HV/MV capacitors/reactors context anchor. Underfollowed lane prioritizes US-listed small/mid-cap or niche suppliers one step away from the obvious grid capex story: PLPC for transmission-line hardware, ALNT via Trans-Coil International for harmonic filters/line reactors/power-quality equipment, and AMSC for D-VAR STATCOM/reactive-power grid-stability systems. Magnet-wire exposure appears harder to express through a clean US-listed pure play in this pass; Quality Power Electrical Equipments remains an India-listed/non-US lead from external context, not included as a US-listed candidate.
